info.name: Test Quality Lab API
info.description:
Manual API tests. Select the 'Test Quality Lab - local' environment, start the stack (docker compose up -d) and run folders top to bottom. Emails are read from Mailpit.

Public auth routes are rate limited per IP (e.g. register 5/min): wait a minute between full runs.

item.name: ai-configs
item.description:
Owner-scoped LLM provider catalog and encrypted credential management (FR-AIC-001, FR-AIC-002, FR-AIC-005). Inherits collection Bearer {{accessToken}} auth.

Contract: docs/api/contracts/ai-config.md

request.description:
FR-AIC-001. Lists supported LLM provider descriptors (groq, gemini, openrouter) and their authentication schemes.

Contract: docs/api/contracts/ai-config.md

FR-AIC-002. Lists configured provider credentials for the owned project with masked key hints (raw credentials are never returned).

Contract: docs/api/contracts/ai-config.md

FR-AIC-002, FR-AIC-005. Encrypts and upserts the provider credential using AES-256-GCM bound to {project_id}:{provider}, returning masked metadata only.

Set {{provider_api_key_placeholder}} locally before sending; never commit real keys.

Contract: docs/api/contracts/ai-config.md

FR-AIC-002. Re-wraps the stored credential envelope from a legacy KEK to the active primary KEK in CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEYS.

Contract: docs/api/contracts/ai-config.md

FR-AIC-002. Hard-deletes the stored provider credential for the project (204 No Content).

Contract: docs/api/contracts/ai-config.md

item.name: prompts
item.description:
Owner-scoped L1-L5 versioned prompt registry, approval lifecycle, and deterministic rendering (FR-PRM-001, FR-PRM-002, FR-PRM-003). Official L1-L5 templates remain unapproved per SRS TBD-04.

Contract: docs/api/contracts/prompts.md

request.description:
FR-PRM-001. Lists L1-L5 strategy summaries for the project (seeded as UNAPPROVED with current_version=0 per SRS TBD-04).

Contract: docs/api/contracts/prompts.md

FR-PRM-001, FR-PRM-002. Registers a new immutable UNAPPROVED prompt version for L1.

IMPORTANT (SRS TBD-04): Official L1-L5 prompt wording is not approved. The payload below is a clearly labeled non-official test example strictly for manual API verification.

Contract: docs/api/contracts/prompts.md

FR-PRM-001. Lists immutable PromptVersion history for strategy L1 newest-first.

Contract: docs/api/contracts/prompts.md

FR-PRM-002. Marks L1 version 1 as APPROVED and transitions any previously approved version to DEPRECATED without mutating historical text or hashes.

Contract: docs/api/contracts/prompts.md

FR-PRM-003. Deterministically renders the active APPROVED version of L1 using safe variable substitution (returns 409 PROMPT_NOT_APPROVED if unapproved).

Contract: docs/api/contracts/prompts.md
